title: Marvel's Return of the Jedi
section: The Comic Art of Star Wars
description: Marvel's Return of the Jedi adaptation used this impressive collage (front, collection of William Plumb) by Bill Sienkiewicz. Luke Skywalker has clearly matured into a Jedi Knight and is ready for his final battle ...and his destiny. Darth, uh, Santa Vader, celebrates Christmas in this Marvel U.K. JEDI WEEKLY cover by Bob Wakelin (back). The tag on Luke's package reads : From Dad.
